name: Modified Interest Subvention Scheme (MISS)
benefit_summary: Crop loans up to ₹3 lakh at an effective interest rate of 4% per year for farmers who repay promptly (2% base subvention + 3% prompt repayment incentive on a 7% base rate)
notes: VERIFY against your own interest_subvention.txt — this benefit is applied automatically by the lending bank on eligible KCC loans, not a separate application; confirm current base rate and subvention percentages.
